title: Factorial
description: Write a function that computes the factorial of a number. The factorial of n (written n!) is the product of all positive integers from 1 to n. For example, 5! = 5 x 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 = 120. The factorial of 0 is defined as 1.
instructions: Complete the factorial function so it returns the correct factorial for any non-negative integer.
hints: Think about what factorial(0) and factorial(1) should return — these are your base cases.
factorial(n) = n x (n-1) x ... x 1. You can use a loop.
Start with result = 1 and multiply by each number from 1 to n in a for loop.
